_readme: Single source for the CV. tools/build-cv.py renders cv/index.html and sv/cv/index.html from it; tools/build-cv-pdf.js prints the A4 PDFs from those pages. {tests} and {hash} are replaced by the stamped values below. Digit groups (49 000) get a non-breaking space at build time.

en.title: iOS Developer · Swift 6 · SwiftUI · Swift Concurrency
en.availability: Open to iOS and mobile roles in Malmö, Lund and Copenhagen · on-site, hybrid or remote
en.profile: iOS developer building native apps in Swift 6 and SwiftUI. Five months on the Mobile Apps team at Axis Communications in Lund, shipping live-video controls and async/await migrations into an established production codebase with code review, QA and Datadog/OpenTelemetry instrumentation. Since then I have built my own iOS projects end to end: an open-source Metal and SwiftUI package with {tests} tests, DocC and CI, a SwiftData app under strict concurrency, and an on-device captioning app built on SpeechAnalyzer and AVFoundation.

bullets: Native iOS apps in Swift 6 and SwiftUI: architecture, implementation, testing, instrumentation and release preparation.
On-device speech and video pipelines with AVFoundation; GPU work with Metal and ARKit. MetalVisualKit maintained with {tests} tests, an example app and CI.
Shipped Swift and SwiftUI features and fixes in an established production iOS app: live-video controls for microphone, speaker and PTZ, and an interactive SwiftUI Canvas interface.
Migrated selected async flows to async/await under strict Swift Concurrency; instrumented a multi-step workflow with Datadog and OpenTelemetry so failures could be traced.
Took work from investigation through pull request, code review, testing and QA alongside iOS and Android developers, using Jira.
Built an Android chat app in Kotlin and Jetpack Compose with authentication, REST API integration and a responsive UI, from product specifications with code review and regular releases.

Swift 6, iOS 17+, {tests} tests, example app, DocC and CI on every push.

projects.name: DeviceMonitor
projects.stack: Swift 6 · SwiftUI · SwiftData · XCTest · XCUITest · GitHub Actions
projects.summary: Degree project: a network-device dashboard with status history, filtering and search. Service, storage and view-model layers behind protocols, actor-safe SwiftData persistence under Swift 6 strict concurrency, 6 unit and 2 UI tests in GitHub Actions. iOS 26.2+.

projects.name: Subtl
projects.stack: Swift 6 · SpeechAnalyzer · AVFoundation · Core Animation · StoreKit 2
projects.summary: Captioning for short-form video with transcription on the device, so nothing leaves the phone. One caption-style model drives both the live preview and the AVFoundation export, so the exported file matches what was edited. Actor-isolated transcription engine; in development, with the support site and privacy policy published.
